warrants.quote: The Representative’s Warrants are exercisable beginning on January 23, 2023, and expire on July 27, 2027, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Representative’s Warrants.

Concurrently with the closing of the public offering, the Company also issued warrants to purchase an aggregate of up to 127,775 shares of its common stock to ThinkEquity or its designees, at an exercise price of $2.8125 per share.
